Calculate Percent Expression

Source: R/PercentExpression.R
PercentExpression.Rd

Calculates the percentage of cells expressing each feature within each cluster. This is an internal function used by CreateConnectome.

Usage

PercentExpression(
  object,
  assays = "RNA",
  features = NULL,
  return.seurat = FALSE,
  add.ident = NULL,
  slot = "counts",
  use.scale = FALSE,
  use.counts = FALSE,
  verbose = TRUE,
  ...
)

Arguments

object

A Seurat object

assays

Assay to use. Default "RNA"

features

Features to calculate. Default NULL uses all features.

return.seurat

Return a Seurat object instead of a list. Default FALSE.

add.ident

Additional identity to include. Default NULL.

slot

Data slot to use. Default "counts".

use.scale

Deprecated. Use slot = "scale.data" instead.

use.counts

Deprecated. Use slot = "counts" instead.

verbose

Print progress messages. Default TRUE.

...

Additional arguments

Value

A list of data.frames with percent expression per cluster
